changes.comment: fallback: fail over from a source that stops at its own head far behind the chain tip (e.g. a Portal dataset without real-time data) once a fresher source is more than `maxLagBlocks` ahead, on both the unfinalized and the finalized stream (the latter compared against the other sources' finalized heads); eager switch-up skips a source whose head trails the committed frontier by more than `maxLagBlocks`
